history.content: Help me get my Orion launch project unstuck.

I’m checking your email for this.

Here's where the search landed: Drive: no Orion files at all. The closest matches were your Series A deck, Northwind meeting notes, and tax docs, none of which touch a launch project. Gmail: the lookup failed on my end, so I can't confirm whether anything Orion related is in your mail. I'd rather tell you that than pretend I checked it. Calendar: that read didn't come back either, so I have nothing on launch related events yet. So I'm stuck on the same thing the project might be: I don't actually know what "Orion launch" refers to for you. Is it a product launch with a date, a marketing campaign, a client project? Give me the one line version and who else is involved, and I'll go straight at the blocker, whether that's digging through mail again, checking the calendar for the launch date, or drafting the nudge to whoever's sitting on it.
